sentences.text: Anna lives in a small town.
One day, Anna has an idea.
The next day, Anna and her friends bring old clothes.
They give the clothes to the school.
The school gives the clothes to kids who need them.
But, there is more to do.
Anna talks to her teacher again.
Anna and her friends bring food.
They give them to the school.
The school gives them to kids who need them.
She knows small actions can help.
Little fires can make a big change.
